decision: Most small AI products are low-risk under the EU AI Act; the main duty is Article 50 transparency (tell users they face AI, mark AI-generated media). Avoid Annex III uses unless ready for high-risk duties. Flow model providers' usage policies into your ToS.
details: Sources conflict on the content-labelling grace period; verify with a lawyer.
